decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The alterations hereby approved shall be completed in full in no more than 6 months time from the date of this approval.

Condition : 2 - All windows in the outbuilding and any side facing windows in the single storey rear extension shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall contain no openable windows and shall be so retained permanently

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be yellow London stock bricks to match those seen at 12 St John's Road, Isleworth.
Condition : 5 - The structure shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the occupation of the main premises as a dental surgery.
description: Retrospective application for the retention of the existing single store side/rear extension and the single storey outbuilding at the rear of the dental surgery following alterations.
